title: RUNNING orphaned containers (without shim)
body:
### Description

Orphaned container found. Container status is showed as RUNNING, but actual shim for those container is dead or doesn't exist.
I haven't yet killed those container in a forceful manner, so i might still gather some valuable information for you to depict the root problem.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

unknown


### Describe the results you received and expected

Expected to have shim and container in a RUNNING state, got only container with RUNNING state, but without a shim.

### What version of containerd are you using?

containerd github.com/containerd/containerd v1.6.6 10c12954828e7c7c9b6e0ea9b0c02b01407d3ae1
